No huge toothy laugh, wink, star eyes, empty grin, embarrassed tears or teacher expression. She can quietly return to the crease if they do not engage.

All room and figure share the exact neutral diffuse DAY luminosity of input 1: broad ivory light through the CLOSED opaque curtain, warm wood reflections and soft receiving contact shadows. No sun beam, solar window lattice, leaf-shadow pattern, readable lake/sky/trees/town, rain, snow or stars. The blue-floral lamp is subtle, not an artificial spotlight. One coherent fresh full painting with a personable small pause.
